programme.title: Bob & Carol & Ted & Alice
programme.desc: 1969. Comedy Drama. Directed by Paul Mazursky. Stars Natalie Wood, Elliott Gould, Robert Culp & Dyan Cannon. Two couples find liberation in the Sexual Revolution of the 1960s.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Unearthly Stranger
programme.desc: 1963. Sci-Fi. Directed by John Krish. Stars John Neville, Phillip Stone, Gabriella Licudi & Warren Mitchell. A government scientist quickly marries a mysterious woman who he knows little about.

programme.title: Somewhere in Camp
programme.desc: 1942. Comedy. Directed by John E. Blakeley. Stars Harry Korris, Frank Randle & Robbie Vincent. Army buddies help Private Trevor court the daughter of their commanding officer.

programme.title: Command Performance
programme.desc: 1937. Stars Finlay Currie. A renowned stage singer leaves the theatre to become a gypsy after his voice weakens. Arthur Tracy (The Street Singer) and Lilli Palmer star in this romantic musical.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Border Town. Directed by Aaron Spelling. Starring Don Durant. After Case Thomas is killed, Ringo and Cully trail the alleged murderer to a wide-open town on the Arizona-New Mexico border.

programme.title: Calling Paul Temple
programme.desc: 1948. Crime Drama starring John Bentley & Dinah Sheridan. Scotland Yard is unable to unravel the 'Rex' murders and cannot manage without the help of Paul Temple and his sidekick 'Steve'.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed for the last half December.

programme.title: Fate Takes a Hand
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Ronald Howard, Christina Gregg, Basil Dignam. Letters recovered from a stolen mail bag significantly impact the lives of the recipients 15 years later.

programme.title: The Shop at Sly Corner
programme.desc: 1946. Thriller. Stars Oskar Homolka, Derek Farr & Muriel Pavlow. Antique dealer Mr. Heiss must deal with a blackmailer who knows of his criminal past.

programme.title: BFI: Post Early for Christmas
programme.desc: 1951. Animation. This delightful silhouette animation may not be the most logical argument for helping the Post Office out, but who cares when it's so charmingly packaged.

programme.title: The Stories Behind the Songs
programme.desc: Join Kate Garner as she plays songs from the past and reveals the stories behind them. In this episode, why did Marie Lloyd follow the van and who was the conman who broke the bank at Monte Carlo?

programme.title: The Larkins
programme.desc: Christmas with the Larkins. 1958. Stars David Kossoff, Peggy Mount & Ruth Trouncer. Ada invites a miserable man to spend Christmas with the family and Alf tries to defrost a meagre frozen turkey.

programme.title: The Crowded Day
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: John Guillermin. Stars Joan Rice, Josephine Griffin, Freda Jackson. The story of the ups and downs of a group of salesgirls at a department store in the run up to Christmas.

programme.title: Please Sir!
programme.desc: 1971. Comedy. Directed by Mark Stuart. Stars John Alderton, Deryck Guyler, & Joan Sanderson. Film version of the TV sitcom. Teacher Bernard Hedges takes his Fenn Street class to a holiday camp.

programme.title: An Inspector Calls
programme.desc: 1954. Crime. Director: Guy Hamilton. Stars Alastair Sim, Olga Lindo, Eileen Moore. The Birling family are rich and complacent. It is 1912, and the impending war has yet to fall across their lives.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Fame and the Fury. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Patrick Holt & Sandra Dome. Celia's partner is a struggling painter. But when she leaves him for a wealthier man, she soon realises her mistake.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Noel and Mike have some rare reels and dazzling interviews with Linda Hayden, Camilla Sparv and Julie Newman! And look out for the new segment, 'Name That Film'.

programme.title: The Racing Game
programme.desc: The Gambling Lady. 1979. Stars Mike Gwilym, Mick Ford & Caroline Blakiston. Sid and Chico are hired to investigate a potential insurance scam. They have to travel to Milan to discover the truth.

programme.title: Gideon's Way
programme.desc: The Great Plane Robbery. Stars John Gregson Alexander Davion and Daphne Anderson. A group of thieves successfully steal a million pound shipment of gold from a plane that just landed from Moscow.

programme.title: The Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: 1976. Drama. Director: George P Cosmatos. Stars Sophia Loren, Richard Harris, Burt Lancaster & Martin Sheen. Passengers of a European train can't escape after a deadly virus is planted.

programme.title: Cannon for Cordoba
programme.desc: 1970. Western. Director: Paul Wendkos. Stars George Peppard, Giovanna Ralli & Raf Vallone. A band of misfits is led into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons stolen by savage revolutionaries.

programme.title: Dateline Diamonds
programme.desc: 1965. Directed By Jeremy Summers. Comedy musical stars The Small Faces, The Chantelles and Kiki Dee. Lester Benson (Kenneth Cope) the manager of top rock band The Small Faces, is hiding a secret.

programme.title: False Colours
programme.desc: 1943. Western. Director: George Archainbaud. Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekicks (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) expose a scheme to replace a ranch heir with an impostor.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: The War of the Colonels. 1956. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Pamela Duncan & Forrest Taylor. A range war started by two ranchers begins to spill over into Wichita and Wyatt Earp is determined to end it.

programme.title: Salute the Toff
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Director: Maclean Rogers. Stars John Bentley and Carol Marsh. Based on the 1941 Novel. The sixth in the series featuring upper-class sleuth, Richard Rollison.

programme.title: The Postman
programme.desc: 1952. In this delightful short film, David Tomlinson plays a postman who brings Christmas Greetings from a host of stars including Phyllis Calvert, Dirk Bogarde and Jack Warner.

programme.title: Scrooge
programme.desc: 1935. Family. Ebenezer Scrooge (Seymour Hicks) is persuaded to change his ways one Christmas by visitations from the ghosts of Christmas past, present and yet-to-come. Also stars Donald Calthrop.

programme.title: Christmas Wishes (1944)
programme.desc: 1944. Charming Halas and Batchelor cartoon encouraging the public to 'post early for Christmas'.

programme.title: Pollyanna
programme.desc: 2002. Drama. Directed by Sarah Harding. Stars Amanda Burton, Tom Bell & Kenneth Cranham. Young orphan Pollyanna, bringing mirth and mayhem to her new home, goes to stay with her Aunt Polly.

programme.title: The Larkins
programme.desc: Strained Relations. 1963. Stars David Kossoff, David Jackson & Robert Easton. The Larkins receive news that Jeff is flying in for Christmas and an ulcer hinders Alf's plans to drink heavily.

programme.title: The Stories Behind the Songs
programme.desc: Kate Garner explores the family parties and singalongs that inspired 'That Old Piano' written by Chas from 'Chas & Dave' and how a toy pig inspired the writers of 'Yes Sir, That's My Baby'.

programme.title: Oliver Twist (1982)
programme.desc: 1982. Drama. Director: Clive Donner. Stars George C. Scott, Tim Curry & Michael Hordern. The classic tale of an orphan boy who finds himself joining a band of thieves after escaping the orphanage.

programme.title: A Night on Mount Edna
programme.desc: 1990. The Dame treats Mel Gibson, Gina Lollobrigida, Julio Iglesias and Charlton Heston to a special Christmas extravaganza at her mountain retreat high in the Swiss Alps!

programme.title: Genevieve
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Director Henry Cornelius. Stars Kenneth More, Dinah Sheridan and Kay Kendall. Alan and Ambrose are not going to let friendship get in the way of winning the London to Brighton rally.

programme.title: Carrie's War
programme.desc: 2004. Drama. Director: Coky Giedroyc. Stars Alun Armstrong, Geraldine McEwan & Jack Stanley. Carrie and her brother are evacuated to Wales where they meet friends who make their time delightful.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: Tusitala
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Roy Kellino. Stars David Niven, Gertrude Michael & John Lupton. Nearing the end of his life, Robert Louis Stevenson mediates between two Samoan tribes to prevent war.

programme.title: Time To Remember
programme.desc: Over By Christmas. 1959. Narrated by Sir Michael Redgrave. An overview of 1914; the rumblings of war become louder across Europe and the recruits leave to fight.

programme.title: A Town Like Alice
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directed by Jack Lee. Stars Virginia McKenna, Peter Finch & Kenji Takaki. While suffering the hardships of being a prisoner of war, Jean meets and befriends captive Australian Joe.

programme.title: Sapphire
programme.desc: 1959. Murder mystery. Directed by Basil Dearden and stars Nigel Patrick, Yvonne Mitchell and Michael Craig. Superintendent Robert Hazard investigates a murder, which could be racially motivated.

programme.title: The Best of Benny Hill
programme.desc: 1974. Comedy. Directed by John Robins. Stars Benny Hill & Patricia Hayes. A brilliant collection of sketches and musical numbers taken from Benny Hill's popular British television show.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline welcomes you back for another evening of chilling horror, this time she introduces the episode Child's Play, about a family who find their home has been sealed off from the outside world.

programme.title: Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense
programme.desc: Child's Play. 1984. Stars Mary Crosby, Nicholas Clay & Debbie Chasan. A family awakens to find themselves trapped in their own home and must quickly find a way to escape.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline returns to give a tantalising taster of next week's spooky episode from the Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense series.

programme.title: The Other Love
programme.desc: 1947. Romantic drama. Seriously ill concert pianist Karen (Barbara Stanwyck) is admitted to a Swiss sanatorium, where she is attracted to the suave Doctor Stanton (David Niven).

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed for the last half December.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts Get Culture. 1963. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Irene Ryan & Donna Douglas. The Clampetts are having no success with their neighbours and decide to get a taste of culture to fit in.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: Three Wise Men. Western with Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray. A young man is told he has less than a year to live and is determined to spend Christmas with his wife and kids.

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: 1966. Fantasy. Directed by Jonathan Miller. Stars Anne-Marie Mallik, Peter Sellers & Wilfrid Brambell. Young girl Alice falls down a rabbit hole into a bizarre world full of eccentric characters.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Christmas Pudding. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Eugene Deckers. A serial killer sentenced to death threatens to kill Sherlock before the execution.

programme.title: Up In The World
